verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a general Files API for creating, reading, editing, moving and deleting files, plus plan-level windows for restoring deleted files (30 days, 180 days, 1 year). Nothing shows API endpoints that list or restore file revisions. The deleted-file windows are a related plan feature, not API-addressable version history, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, version history is addressable — file revisions can be listed and restored via the API, with documented retention windows
